speaker_segments.text: I like that, and I'm going to play an under for a kicker later in the show that relates to weather. Let's get to the picks, starting with running backs. Proppy has Omarion Hampton over 37.5 rushing yards.

speaker_segments.text: Usually when I have that feeling about a prop, I get that Spidey sense. speaker_segments.speaker: Sia
speaker_segments.text: It would be a no play for me. I think this is a Chase Brown game, and we don't know the status of Tee Higgins.

speaker_segments.text: I have Commanders kicker Drew Stevens under 1.5 field goals made at +113. Heavy rain is expected, and the Giants have only given up one made field goal all year.

speaker_segments.speaker: Sia
